_comment: Three worked examples of the write contract. Not a schema -- a readable sample. See agent-interface-spec-ja.md section 3.

example1_acceptedBatch._what: One atomic batch: push the design finish, move the milestone, and record why. One Undo step, one changeLog entry.

request.changeExplanation: verification cannot start before detailed design ends. moved it to 2027-01-15 and left the deadline at 2026-12-20 so the gap stays visible.

example2_staleBaseRevision._what: The human committed an edit between the agent's read and its write. This fired 6 times in the trial.

outcome.document: <current document, so the caller can retry without another read>

example2_staleBaseRevision._retry: Re-read from outcome.document, decide again, resend with baseRevision 12. Do not blindly resend the same command.

example3_atomicRollback._what: Second command is invalid, so the first is rolled back too. The document never shows a half-applied state.

example4_watchLoop._what: The loop that removes the human from the notification path. Pseudo-code, in call order.

steps.note: sinceRevision is REQUIRED. Omitting it caused a busy loop in the trial.
the human dragged a bar, or typed an instruction in the chat panel, or both
read + write + record the reason in ONE round trip; the returned revision re-arms the watch
re-arm with the revision that applyCommands just returned -- no extra read
